final_claim: For \(q\ge3\), the two-dimensional finite-field total dot-product graph has zero-forcing polynomial \(u^{(q+1)(q-2)}(u+q-1)^{q+1}\), real minimum rank \(q+1\), and \(Z=M=q^2-q-2\); its minimum zero-forcing sets are exactly complements of projective transversals. The binary boundary is \(K_1\dot\cup K_2\) with polynomial \(2u^2+u^3\).
